observations: Close-up of a tire tread with a manufacturer label attached.
Label identifies the brand as Dunlop and model as Grandtrek PT5.
Label specifies size 265/60R18 and load/speed rating 110V.
Tread appears deep and unused, consistent with a new tire.
Watermark 'FRANCOBEST ENT' suggests a commercial seller.
Only the tread and a small portion of the shoulder are visible; sidewalls are hidden.

claims.evidence: Quality and performance are subjective and depend on the age and storage conditions of the rubber.

risks.risk: The tire may be old stock (expired rubber).
risks.proof: A photo of the sidewall showing the 4-digit DOT manufacture code.
Clear photos of both the inner and outer sidewalls.

risks.risk: The listing may be for a single tire despite the plural 'tires' in text.
risks.proof: A photo showing all tires offered in a single shot.

proof_requests: Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall to verify the manufacture date.
Photos of both the inner and outer sidewalls of the tire(s).
A photo showing all tires included in the sale together.
response.reason: The brand, model, and size are clearly legible on the factory label in photo 0, allowing for a baseline valuation even at worst-case (old stock, single unit).
